methodologyNotes: This dataset covers walk-behind push and self-propelled lawn mowers (gas and battery). Each product was adversarially re-verified against manufacturer pages and major retailers (Home Depot, Lowe's, Amazon) plus authorized dealers and review sites in June 2026. priceUsd reflects current published US list price or manufacturer MSRP for the EXACT model/config named; where the draft confused a sibling model's MSRP the price was corrected (e.g. Honda HRX217VKA base MSRP is $769, not the $879 of the VLA/VYA). self_propelled is boolean; discharge_modes lists supported clipping-handling modes; battery_ah is the capacity of the battery included in the kit (null for gas); engine_cc_or_voltage records cc for gas or nominal voltage for electric. accessedAt 2026-06-19. EGO decks are poly/composite (the draft's 'steel deck' on LM2156SP was a fabrication, corrected to poly). Greenworks MO80L410 price is a verified street price (~$400), not a formal MSRP. Snapper SXD21SPWM82K is a 2019 model (not 2017) and its weak aggregator source was replaced with the Amazon product page.
